Once land has been divided into streets, blocks, lots, and open spaces, a pattern has been established which usually determines how well community needs for residence, business, and industry will be met. It also determines to a great extent how well the community will be able to handle its traffic circulation problems, how well it will be able to meet the demands for home sites, and how efficiently and economically it will be able to provide the many services demanded of it.
